lines.text: Ballot Measure Primary Argument Submission Form
A ballot argument will not be accepted unless accompanied by this completed typed form, which shall contain the
printed name(s) and signature(s) of the person(s) submitting it or, if submitted on behalf of a bona fide association of
citizens, the name of the association and the printed name and signature of at least one of its principal officers.
Please make sure you are using proper format before submitting to the Elections Office.
Word count limit for Primary Arguments = 300 words

No more than five signatures shall appear with any argument. If more than five signatures
are submitted, the first five listed shall be printed. Names and titles listed will be printed in
the order that they are listed below. Place a checkmark in the author column if the signer is
the author of the argument. A signer can only list one title. Honorifics such as M.D., Dr.,
Esquire, etc. with a name are not accepted.

To maintain East Palo Alto's safe, clean drinking water, help our kids, and keep our community safe,
YES ON PROTECTS EAST PALO ALTO'S SAFE, CLEAN DRINKING WATER
" upgrades deteriorating pipes that distribute our drinking water and installs drinking water
storage tanks large enough to support future City growth.
Prevents pollution from entering the Bay and our streets
Repairs aging storm drains to prevent neighborhood flooding
YES ON" " INVESTS IN OUR CHILDREN/YOUTH
We must invest in the future of our kids! East Palo Alto needs more safe places for our young people,
especially after school and during summer. For example, our library is undersized, overcrowded and
lacks adequate space for the literacy and children's programming our families depend on.
provides a modern library with up-to-date technology, hands on learning spaces, and
dedicated areas for children and teens so they have somewhere safe to go after school and in the
summer. Creation of a youth sports park provides opportunities for kids to learn, play and gather —
keeping them safely out of trouble.
